agent.label: Euler
agent.reason: The two-parameter Euler model had the lowest pooled leave-one-trajectory-out 5 s `x` RMSE among the tested family/criterion combinations (approximately 0.0291 m across all held-out windows in data/train.csv). It is translation invariant, compact and finite. The nonlinear alternatives explain settled-command residuals but do not consistently improve held-out `x` simulation. These validation windows overlap and involve only three trajectories, so the small differences are uncertain; this is not a claim about hidden test performance.

settings.discontinuities: expressions with jumps (Piecewise, sign) are evaluated pointwise at the sample instants and Runge-Kutta stages; no event detection or step refinement is applied at a jump
